chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام would eat on the Day of al-Fiṭr before going out to the prayer place, and he would not eat on the Day of al-Aḍḥā until he slaughtered.

key_terms.الْمُصَلَّى: the place designated for the Eid prayer

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali’s practice regarding eating on Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding eating on the two Eid days. He would eat before going to the Eid al-Fiṭr prayer area, while on Eid al-Aḍḥā he would delay eating until after the sacrifice.
